title: Dbias: Detecting biases and ensuring Fairness in news articles
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the ability of a pipeline (Dbias) to detect and mitigate biases in news articles. This included detecting biases related to religion as a protected attribute.
findings: The paper finds that its Dbias pipeline can effectively detect and mitigate various types of biases, including those related to religion, in news articles. While specific quantitative results for religion alone are not provided, it is treated as one of the protected attributes where the model showed improved fairness metrics (Disparate Impact and G-AUC) compared to baseline methods. The analysis of the dataset confirmed the presence of religious terms, such as 'Christians', in biased contexts.
